items.title: Feyenoord verslikt zich na Europese euforie in PEC, Ajax haalt opnieuw flink uit
items.summary: De Rotterdamse euforie van woensdag verdween drie dagen later als sneeuw voor de zon. Feyenoord won midweeks ruim van Valerenga in de Women's Europa Cup maar ging daarna in de eigen competitie onderuit tegen PEC Zwolle. Ajax heeft de smaak ondertussen te pakken en veegde de vloer aan met ADO Den Haag.

items.title: Heracles heeft geen kind aan Vitesse en profiteert optimaal van misstap Almere
items.summary: Heracles heeft zich prima hersteld van de nederlaag bij Almere City een week geleden. Vitesse kwam zaterdag langs in het Asito Stadion en was geen partij voor de Almeloërs. Topschutter Jean-Paul N'Djoli was maar weer eens trefzeker in de Keuken Kampioen Divisie.

items.title: Tevreden overwinningsspeech Van Bommel na Belgisch debuut: 'Plezier is belangrijk'
items.summary: Mark van Bommel was een tevreden man vrijdagavond. De trainer debuteerde als bondscoach van België en zag zijn Rode Duivels meteen afrekenen met Italië . De media-afdeling van de Belgen legde de speech in de kleedkamer na afloop vast.

items.title: Pocognoli’s reign as Scotland coach begins with stalemate in Slovenia
items.summary: Sébastien Pocognoli grimaced on Friday when recalling his debut as an international player for Belgium. Alessandro del Piero and Italy discovered favourable opposition when preparing for the 2006 World Cup. Pocognoli will also look back, in time, at his first game as the manager of Scotland. Blue skies, a dainty stadium in Ljubljana and a second-half display that provided glimpses of optimism in respect of Scotland’s world, post-Steve Clarke. The best-forgotten first 45 minutes can be explained away by a squad operating under a new regime. By full time, Slovenia were grateful for their point. Scotland’s players took deserved applause. items.title: Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game
items.summary: Republic of Ireland players intend to wear black armbands "in recognition of all lives lost in the [Gaza] conflict" for Sunday's Nations League game against Israel in Hungary, after confirming they will go ahead with the fixture.

items.title: Manchester City chair Al Mubarak insists ‘nothing has changed’ after guilty verdict
items.summary: ‘We have faced challenges together before and have prevailed’ Maresca quotes Socrates on social media – ‘I know nothing’ Khaldoon Al Mubarak, the Manchester City chair, has spoken for the first time since the club was found guilty on virtually all counts of breaching Premier League financial rules. He said “nothing has changed” and “our confidence and intent in proving the club’s innocence is just as strong as when this began”. News broke on Friday that City had been found guilty on all but one of the 115 charges laid by the Premier League in February 2023, charges the club have always strenuously denied. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Island girl’ Malard aims to become a legend with Bompastor at Chelsea
items.summary: She left her Indian Ocean island home at the urging of her current manager and now they are working together again in pursuit of trophies at Stamford Bridge It is rare to see Melvine Malard without a grin and she has a mountain of reasons to keep it that way. A wedding in June, a big-money move to Chelsea, a Ballon d’Or nomination and a first taste of a London derby against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge on Sunday. The France forward is loving life and the personality behind the smile that instantly connects her to teammates is infectious. “Goals,” says Malard, with a laugh, when asked what keeps her happy. “Seriously though, it’s seeing the kids, the families, my family, in the stands. It is crazy. I love my life, I love my job, I’m happy with my wife and everything is good. I smile because of those things, because I’m happy.” Continue reading...

items.title: Des remontrances de Felice Mazzù aux louanges de Mark van Bommel : "Il ne travaillait pas assez"
items.summary: Dodi Lukebakio a sorti sa séquence fétiche contre l'Italie : un dribble vers l'intérieur du jeu suivi d'une frappe enroulée du gauche dans le petit filet opposé. La Squadra n'avait rien vu venir. Felice Mazzù, qui l'a eu sous ses ordres à Charleroi, constate les progrès effectués par son ancien joueur.

items.title: "Je ne sais pas si je peux le dire" : Besnik Hasi a tenté de débaucher un leader d'Anderlecht en Turquie

L'effectif comprend notamment Yira Sor, David Bates, Mbaye Diagne et Gift Orban, des visages familiers du football belge. Colin Coosemans aurait tout aussi bien pu en faire partie. items.title: Un nouveau changement d'entraîneur durant la trêve ? Le directeur sportif monte au créneau
items.summary: Malines a débuté la saison de manière décevante, avec seulement 3 points sur 21. N'ayant toujours pas remporté de victoire, l'équipe occupe actuellement la dernière place du classement de Pro League. Elle continue donc de se remettre en question durant cette trêve internationale. Mais toujours sous la houlette de Fred Vanderbiest, qui sera toujours bel et bien aux commandes du groupe à la reprise.

items.title: 🎥 "Mes compliments, les gars" : au coeur du discours de Mark van Bommel comme si vous y étiez

Il mettait surtout en avant le collectif et la gestion de la rencontre.
